fields.note: filterDef.allFilters department (10 options, searchConfig.departmentField=job_function). Verified: filter_department=Assembly & Test was echoed in data.appliedFilters. Job rows also carry finer codes (AEBU, CDBU, GCM, ...) that are not facet options.

fields.label: Country
fields.note: filter_country is silently dropped by this tenant (not echoed in appliedFilters), so country is filtered locally; use location=India for a native equivalent.

fields.label: Seniority
fields.note: filterDef.allFilters seniority publishes the labels Entry/Mid/Senior/Intern/Director/Executive/CXO with codes 1/2/0/3/5; filter_seniority was not exercised, so this field is applied locally on titles.

notes: careers.micron.com is an Eightfold PCSX shell. Listing is GET /api/pcsx/search with domain=micron.com, query, location, start (10 rows per page), sort_by and filter_<facet>; the site config sets basePositionFq 'position.system_id:workday AND is_externally_posted:1 AND -location_country:CN', departmentField job_function and allFilters [skills, department, seniority, work_location_option]. Live checks: empty query -> 2872, query=engineer -> 2459, location=India -> 316, filter_department + filter_work_location_option echoed in data.appliedFilters, filter_country dropped. Sort menu publishes Company priority (sort_by=hot, the UI default) and Latest (sort_by=timestamp, used by the collector).
